title: The Lantern Stair
author: Gamebook Player sample
rights: Original sample text written for this repository. It is not a published gamebook, and this repository has no chosen license for it.

sections.title: The stair
body: A narrow stair climbs between two walls of old brick. A lantern hangs from a peg at the first step, still warm.
The dark above the third step does not show what made the scuff marks.

choices.label: Stand and face the pale moth

sections.title: The landing
body: You stop on a landing where someone drew a small box in chalk.
The box is a tick, the kind a traveller makes so they know they have been here before.

choices.label: Tick the box and study the mark
The box is ticked. Walk on.
Search the crack in the brick

sections.title: The mark
body: You hold the lantern close to the chalk. The lines look like a letter you almost know.

sections.title: The reading
body: The letter settles in your memory. You could find this mark again.

sections.title: The scrape
body: Your foot slips on the worn edge. The fall is short, and your knee stings.

sections.title: The arch
body: Something small and pale flaps under the arch. It is not a bird. It keeps to the air in front of the next step.
You can wait it out, one breath at a time.

sections.title: Above
body: The stair ends at a plain wooden door, shut and warm from the other side. This sample ends here.
You can climb back down. The stair will still be there.

choices.label: Leave the lantern by the door

sections.title: The step
body: You sit until the stair stops tilting. When you stand, the way up is still there.

choices.label: Catch your breath and start again

sections.title: The crack
body: A crack runs between two bricks. It is wide enough for a hand, and dark past the first knuckle.

sections.title: The pale moth
body: A pale moth drops from the brick and stays in front of your face. It does not leave until you have stood through two breaths.
